scope: Independent source review of guest Chat acceptance sequencing and its guard; no native browser run

evidence: The chip-open, opening-send, and follow-up-send owner-table assertions were removed; the remaining GET assertion follows the opening and follow-up answer assertions and their screenshot captures.
The observer attaches before fresh-guest checks, snapshots requests after each phase, and the final assertion examines the final snapshot for any GET regardless of HTTP status.
Fresh guest storage checks, unpredictable article codes, stream/answer grounding, reload guest checks, and before/after artifact hash checks remain in the acceptance path.
limits: A failing answer, fixture, reload, or screenshot still stops the ordinary path before the final GET assertion; the failure path records observations and attempts a failure screenshot, and the run remains failed.
The network observer declares that requests before attachment are outside its measurement scope; only a native run can establish live behavior.

evidence: node --test tests/browser/guest-chat-store-sequence.test.mjs passed: its extracted actual tail rejects chip-open and post-reload GET snapshots after capturing the follow-up screenshot, and accepts an empty snapshot.
The guard also checks the source order of both answer assertions and screenshot calls and requires one owner-table GET assertion. No production code or alternate implementation was added.
verdict_B.limitation: The guard executes only the extracted final tail with doubles; it does not run a native side panel or prove the whole acceptance flow under a real owner-table request.
